description: This file defines the ISiloStatusListener interface, which declares a method for receiving notifications about silo status changes within the Orleans runtime ecosystem.

classes.name: ISiloStatusListener
classes.description: Interface for components that listen to silo status change notifications in Orleans.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles the receipt of a silo status change notification, updating the listener about a specific silo's status.
